entries.010df156496708cc: Its strength lies in its unique '4-station system,' which combines four processes in one machine: preform molding, temperature conditioning, blow molding and removal. Temperature conditioning makes it possible to handle containers with complex shapes, and the 'Zero Cooling System' is said to improve productivity and quality while reducing weight at the same time. A further feature is a structure that supports machines, molds and molding technology as one integrated package.
entries.037a86599d1a0f7e: It manufactures and sells stretch blow molding machines for producing various plastic containers, including PET bottles, as well as their dedicated molds, auxiliary equipment and parts. Its main product is the one-step machine, which performs preform molding and blow molding in one unit.

entries.6a3b69a18cbf721b: As its management philosophy, the company states 'Providing richness to people and society' and 'Pursuing permanent survival through advanced technology and service.' Its medium- to long-term management strategy states that, on the technology side, it will work on improving the competitiveness of its mainstay one-step machines, strengthening response to environmentally friendly containers and expanding the PF series lineup; on the sales side, it will develop customers in emerging markets, spread the control and monitoring system 'Vision1' and strengthen after-sales service; and on the production side, it will increase production capacity and rebuild its group production structure.
